notes.title: Update information Ver2.00
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35234635/266936764f5f665a3596db3434e656c418eb382f.png
Thank you everyone for enjoying our game.

-Update Information ver2.00-
Add
 Added the Roguelike Dungeon "Back World Dungeon".
You can challenge from the big hole that appeared in front of the northern Demonic Castle.
 Added two new special move.
You can learn by advancing the roguelike dungeon.
 Added a function that data transfer from the free version.
 honored the winner of Survival Island Score Attack Video Festival.
Thank you, 嘿呀，果粒橙~(我的果粒橙呢)-san!
Thank you, jimmy09172000(十字的遊玩遊戲)-san!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35234635/726dd88999434c98b99e7a9df7cb1ec73ba24465.png

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35234635/23578937907ed1abeaffe8aeed649d494baec02e.png
Bug Fix
 Fixed some Korean and Chinese (Traditional/Simplified) text.
 Fixed a bug that you cannot use special moves on Survival Island.

You can play Rogue-like mode up to the 50th floor.
Expect more floors in future updates!

Rogue-like mode might find something wrong.
In that case, I would appreciate it if you could write on the community hub.
If you send me a screenshot, We can solve the problem faster.
Thanks for your help!

Thank you very much for your help in translating!
Thanks to your help, We were able to create a very attractive Rogue-like mode.
We really appreciate it. Thank you!

Have a good adventure!

notes.title: Update information Ver1.02
notes.content:
Thank you everyone for enjoying our game.

Two weeks have passed since the game was released.
We have prepared an fun and absurd content "Survival Island" for all players.

 Update information Ver1.02
Bug Fix
 Fixed some Korean and Chinese (Traditional/Simplified) text.
 Debug mode removed.

Add
 Added well challenge "Try to Survive! Survival Island".

Notice
 Security software "Avast" has reported a false positive for a virus to "Avast". It will be added to the "Avast" whitelist.
 Security software "Kaspersky" has reported a false positive for a virus to "Kaspersky". It will be added to the "Kaspersky" whitelist.

Please be assured that the update will not affect the play data.

Have a good adventure!
